name: scanning-iac-and-images-with-trivy
author: mukul975
description: Scans container images, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes manifests, Dockerfile, Helm), filesystems, git repos, and SBOMs with Trivy's vuln, misconfig, secret, and license scanners. Use when building a CI/CD security gate that scans images before push, IaC before apply, or SBOMs for supply-chain weaknesses, and fails the build on policy violations.
